profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced software engineer with strong background in both RESTful API and front end development. Extensive knowledge of common frameworks for Python, JavaScript, and Java languages. Demonstrated ability to own all stages of feature development from requirements gathering and design to deployment and maintenance.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained high-traffic RESTful APIs built with Django, Spring Boot, and PostgreSQL along with front ends using the Ember.js framework.
• Managed deployments and infrastructure with Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform, and Jenkins.
positions.insights: REST APIs, Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) and +24 skills

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed multiple web-based applications for customers in data research environments using Express, React, Flask, and MongoDB.
• Utilized Agile development to lead the software team across multiple projects.
• Coordinated with hardware, testing, support, and sales teams to ensure software was released in a timely manner and addressed priority issues.
• Led university capstone program teams in completing several 3-month projects for the company.
positions.insights: REST APIs, Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) and +19 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented an automated data analysis workflow feature using Docker containerization.
• Led the development of a role-based permission system for a data management product, consisting of gathering requirements from other teams, architecture, and implementation.
• Automated software packaging and installation using Ansible and shell scripting.
• Managed cloud deployments using AWS EC2 and on local hardware using VMware ESXi.
• Documented software in detail and according to FDA medical software standards.
positions.insights: REST APIs, Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) and +19 skills

positions.title: Student Software Developer
positions.description:
• Developed RESTful APIs for use by various web and mobile applications for the university.
• Maintained a continuous integration and continuous delivery pipeline using Jenkins.
• Containerized numerous applications using Docker and scripted automated deployment.
• Utilized Ansible and Vagrant for configuration management of on-premise servers.
positions.insights: REST APIs, Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) and +25 skills

honors.title: Oregon State University Presidential Scholarship
honors.description: Received the Presidential Scholarship in the amount of $40,000 for academic success.
honors.issuer: Issued by Oregon State University · Sep 2016
